name: PBD counter-trend swing framework (Patrick Nill) - objective rule set for XAUUSD
status: BASELINE SPECIFICATION. No 'Gold Strategy Specification' is issued: see FINAL_REPORT.md section 20.
instrument: XAUUSD spot (Dukascopy bid bars; XM GOLD spread/swap)
primary_timeframe: M15 (UTC-aligned, bar time = floor to 15 min)
execution_timeframe: M1 path for stops, targets, MFE/MAE

sessions_utc_dst_aware.overlap: London and New York both open (08:00-16:30 London AND 08:00-17:00 New York)

weekly_value_area.week: Sunday 21:00 UTC to next Sunday 21:00 UTC
weekly_value_area.volume_source_primary: Dukascopy traded volume on M1 bars (single-venue real volume, NOT COMEX, NOT footprint)
volume_source_sensitivity: XM MT5 tick volume on M15
weekly_value_area.bin_width_usd: max(0.10, round(0.00025 * first high of the week, 2))
weekly_value_area.distribution: each bar's volume spread uniformly over every bin its low-high touches
weekly_value_area.expansion: from POC, two bins at a time toward the side with more volume (CBOT method)
weekly_value_area.reference_used_for_trading: PREVIOUS COMPLETED week's VAH / VAL / POC for the whole current week (no look-ahead)
weekly_value_area.developing_variant: current-week VA recomputed at every M15 close from bars up to that close (sensitivity only)

definitions_tested.atr: |close[i] - close[i-N]| >= imp_k * ATR14[i-N] and efficiency_ratio >= imp_eff
definitions_tested.pct: |close[i] - close[i-N]| >= trailing-30-day 98th percentile of |N-bar moves| and efficiency_ratio >= imp_eff
definitions_tested.rangeexp: N-bar high-low range >= imp_rexp * trailing-30-day median N-bar range and efficiency_ratio >= imp_eff
definitions_tested.consec: >= imp_consec consecutive same-direction closes and |move| >= 2 * ATR14[i-N]

impulse.efficiency_ratio: |net move| / sum(|close-to-close changes|) over the window
impulse.origin: lowest low (P) / highest high (B) within 4N bars before the window, accepted only if the path from it to the extreme never retraced more than 50% of itself; otherwise the window's own extreme
impulse.extreme_tracking: the extreme keeps updating while price makes new highs (P) / lows (B) before a range forms
impulse.abandon_if: close retraces more than 61.8% of the impulse, or no range forms within 24 bars of the extreme
impulse.structure_type: P = upward impulse then range; B = downward impulse then range; the impulse is never traded

consolidation_range.window_position: the last 8 bars, which must start at or after the impulse extreme bar
consolidation_range.location: range low (P) must sit above origin + 38.2% of the impulse (range high below for B)
consolidation_range.range_high: highest high of the confirmation window (frozen)
consolidation_range.range_low: lowest low of the confirmation window (frozen)
consolidation_range.touch: a bar entering the 20%-of-width zone at a boundary (consecutive bars count once)
consolidation_range.min_touches_required_baseline: 1 per side by construction (touch filters tested separately)

playbook_A_pingpong.long_signal: bar low <= range_low + 0.20*width AND close > range_low AND close <= range_low + 0.5*width AND side re-armed
playbook_A_pingpong.rearm: a new same-side signal needs a close at least 30% of width away from that boundary first
playbook_A_pingpong.entry: market at the open of the M1 bar after the signal bar close (+1 min delay in the realistic model)
playbook_A_pingpong.target: boundary +/- 0.9 * width (just inside the opposite boundary)
playbook_A_pingpong.stops_when: a valid breakout occurs (setup invalid) or the range expires

playbook_B_breakout_pullback.breakout: M15 close beyond a boundary by >= 0.25 * ATR14 (confirmation variants: bar range >= 1.5 ATR, volume >= 1.5x 20-bar average, both)
playbook_B_breakout_pullback.pullback: within 16 bars a bar reaches boundary +/- 0.25 ATR and closes on the breakout side
playbook_B_breakout_pullback.failed_breakout: close back inside the range by > 0.25 ATR -> back to RANGE state
playbook_B_breakout_pullback.entry: market after the pullback bar closes
playbook_B_breakout_pullback.stop: beyond min/max(pullback extreme, boundary) by 0.5 * ATR14
playbook_B_breakout_pullback.B2_variant: entry at the breakout close without waiting for the pullback

management.max_hold: 288 M15 bars (72 h), exit at the next M1 open
management.risk_per_trade: 1% of equity (all statistics in R; the 1%-compounding curve starts at 10,000 USD)

costs_realistic.spread: XM GOLD per-bar spread (median 0.25 USD in 2022 to 0.40 USD in 2026); long pays the ask, short exits at the ask
costs_realistic.commission: 0 (XM Standard); 0.07 USD/oz ECN variant in the sensitivity table
costs_realistic.execution_delay: fill at the open of the M1 bar starting 1 min after the signal bar close
costs_realistic.intrabar_rule: stop and target in the same M1 bar -> stop first; open beyond the stop -> filled at the open

data_split.walk_forward: test years 2023-2026, candidate chosen on all earlier years

version_B_footprint: NOT AVAILABLE. No bid/ask footprint or COMEX order-flow data exists in the dataset. Tick volume and Dukascopy volume are not treated as footprint data.
